recommendation.title: Recommended: Moss. Runner-up for energy: Warm
points: Moss answers the "green but still lively" question. It is the app's own green identity pushed to B's boldness: a vivid leaf-green field, a deep forest ink, marigold for the partner and the Deeds badge, a deep peacock disc for you. It reads as the same app grown up, not a new brand.

It keeps B's structure intact. Field, then discs, then ink, with the overlap still reading as two inks (peacock over marigold makes an olive lens). Ink on the field is 6.2:1, the best of the green options.

It is safer than B for colour-blind users. 0 contrast failures and 0 colour-blind flags, against 5 flags for the control. After review, success moved off green so "Photo captured" no longer reads as a fourth green.
Watch: the olive lens is a little dull against the green field. If more punch is wanted there, it is a one-token change.
Choose Warm if energy matters more than continuity: the tangerine field against a deep sea-blue disc is the only scheme that rebuilds B's complementary punch, with the best contrast of all six.

Choose Moss Linen only if continuity with today's beige ground matters most; it bends B's no-cream rule. Calm suits a quieter product, Cool is closest to B's own overprint but the coolest in temperature.

adopt: Copy the colors.js export from the chosen scheme's scheme.md into mobile/theme/colors.js, keeping the palette as swappable role tokens, and keep design-candidates/B/direction.md for everything else (read its colour names through the mapping table at the end of each scheme.md). For the overnight redesign run: "adopt design-candidates/B/direction.md with the palette from design-candidates/B-schemes/<scheme>/scheme.md". That run starts from main, so merge this branch first or copy those files onto main.

schemes.name: Control (B)
schemes.mood: Party poster: hot pink field, ink blue, yellow and a clean green lens. The benchmark for energy.
schemes.contrast: Passes AA everywhere; text on the pink field is the tightest pair (4.83).
schemes.colorblind: 5 flags: the violet lens nearly matches your blue disc under red-green deficiency; success is the same green as the main lens; mint and pink merge under deuteranopia.
schemes.critique: Strongest hierarchy and the most intuitive overprint (blue + yellow = green). Hot pink reads more event than trust.
schemes.risk: Weakest colour-blind safety of the six.

schemes.name: Moss
schemes.mood: Community garden on a sunny Saturday: vivid green, marigold, peacock.
schemes.contrast: 0 failures; ink on field 6.2; white on the olive lens is the tightest (about 4.5, large text there).
schemes.colorblind: 0 flags, 9 mild warnings (covered by initials and the person icon).
schemes.critique: The most direct continuation of the app's green identity at B's boldness. Green had too many jobs; success was moved off green after review.
schemes.risk: Green for brand, field and selection can blur meanings on dense screens; the olive lens is dull on green.

schemes.name: Moss Linen
schemes.mood: Moss's liveliness on today's familiar linen ground.
schemes.ground: Linen (deliberate exception to B's no-cream rule)
schemes.contrast: 0 failures; ink, edge, placeholder and disabled retuned for linen.
schemes.colorblind: 0 flags, 9 warnings (same people and lenses as Moss).
schemes.critique: Reads most like the same app as today while keeping B's field, discs and type. Card separation from the linen ground was weak; retuned after review.
schemes.risk: Dilutes B's crisp white world toward the old beige look; cards rely on small tonal steps.

schemes.name: Warm
schemes.mood: Food-bank day poster: tangerine, marigold, deep sea-blue, wine ink. Appetizing and sociable.
schemes.contrast: 0 failures; best contrast stack of the six (ink on field 6.6, ink on white 16.5).
schemes.colorblind: 0 flags, 8 warnings; the olive lens and orange field are close under protanopia.
schemes.critique: The most energetic after the control; orange against the sea-blue disc rebuilds B's complementary punch. Moved off a plum disc in review to avoid a Halloween read.
schemes.risk: The olive lens on tangerine can look muddy.

schemes.name: Cool
schemes.mood: Beach clean-up morning: aqua field, navy-teal ink, cobalt, sunny yellow, coral.
schemes.contrast: 0 failures; ink on field 7.1, the strongest field text.
schemes.colorblind: 0 flags, 8 warnings (lens-3 close to you and its disc).
schemes.critique: Closest to B's own overprint: a saturated cobalt disc with yellow and a clean green lens, on a less hot field.
schemes.risk: The loudest region is the coolest hue, so it can read like a travel or banking app.

schemes.name: Calm
schemes.mood: Riso on soft stock: heather field, aubergine ink, dusty slate, mustard, clay.
schemes.colorblind: 0 flags, 11 mild warnings; your disc was lifted away from the ink after review.
schemes.critique: The quietest; reads as a safe, unpressured way to meet someone. Hierarchy holds by value rather than chroma.
schemes.risk: Least energetic; the pale field lets the darker discs pull the eye. Dusty tints can feel muted on a dim phone.
